title: Setup text - need to make it less
symptom: On Q1 Pro, only January 2018 version can be installed; later versions (alpha, beta) cannot be installed because the installation text is too long and does not reach the last lines, preventing the Install button from being clicked on small display devices.
fix: The only solution mentioned is to remove the existing app and install fresh, but this is not a proper fix.
evidence_quote: not able to click "Install", due to small screen size. By now only solution is to remove existing and install fresh.
